Paragraph with bold, italic, and a link

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>This has <strong>bold</strong>, <em>italic</em>, and a <a href=\"https://example.com\">link</a>.</p>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
